I reviewed `d0e03bb..HEAD` (committed only, 1 file, +0 −170) and found nothing to fix. This PR is ready to open.

## Summary

| | |
|---|---|
| **Verdict** | Ready to open the PR |
| **Score** | 100 in the three areas this diff touches · 0 findings, so nothing needed adjudicating |
| **What changed** | Deletes `.github/workflows/mirror-to-ghcr.yml`, a manually triggered, one-off workflow that copied Docker Hub tags to GHCR |
| **Fix first** | Nothing |

**Context:** `origin/dev` already has this change as `1ac39361d` (#8715). It also has #8719, which makes `web-deploy-dockerhub.yml` push to `ghcr.io/safe-global/safe-wallet-web` alongside Docker Hub. So the mirror was the only thing writing to GHCR, and #8719 replaces it for future images.

## Scores by area

| Area | Score | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Security | 100 | The deletion only removes access. The workflow's `packages: write` permission and its use of the Docker Hub credential go with it. Nothing else lost a guard. |
| Regression | 100 | Nothing refers to this workflow: no other workflow, `AGENTS.md`, docs or scripts. It only ran when started by hand, so no trigger is lost. |
| Conventions | 100 | The `ci:` commit prefix matches repo history. No `AGENTS.md` update is needed. |
| Bugs, testing, architecture, performance, DRY, KISS | n/a | A deleted YAML file has no code, tests, module layout or duplication to check |

## Not sure about this

- **A gap in GHCR tags if the two PRs land far apart.** On this branch by itself, no workflow writes to GHCR at all, because the push step only exists in #8719. Any Docker Hub tag pushed between the mirror's last real run (not a dry run) and #8719 merging won't exist on GHCR, and this PR removes the tool that could copy it over. I can't tell from the repo whether the mirror ran for real, or whether the Docker Hub migration was signed off (the deleted file's own header said to delete it only after that). The risk is small: the workflow can be restored from `322235464` if a backfill is needed, and the Docker Hub credential still exists (`web-deploy-dockerhub.yml:50-51`).
  - `.github/workflows/mirror-to-ghcr.yml:1` (deleted)

## Ruled out
- **Other workflows still depend on the Docker Hub secrets.** They do, but `web-deploy-dockerhub.yml` uses them on its own, so deleting the mirror doesn't affect that.

## Not checked
- Whether the mirror ran with `dry_run: false`, and whether GHCR has all the listed tags. That needs registry or Actions access, and the `gh` CLI was off limits.
- Files outside the diff. One line in passing: `web-deploy-dockerhub.yml` puts `${{ github.event.release.tag_name || inputs.tag }}` straight into a `run:` script. Those values come only from maintainers, and it's not part of this change.

## Worth tidying
Nothing. The only file touched was deleted.

## How this was produced
- **Scope:** I pinned the base to `d0e03bb` and the head to `baf871c`, and reviewed committed work only. The two untracked folders (`.claude/skills/code-conventions/`, `docs/engineering/`) were left out.
- **Checks:** I read the full deleted file and searched the repo, `origin/dev` and `origin/main` for references to the workflow, GHCR, and the Docker Hub image and secrets.
- **Shortcuts:** The diff is one YAML file being deleted, so I ran the checks myself instead of starting nine reviewer agents. With no findings, the validate-and-refute step and the score history file were skipped.
- **Read-only:** Nothing was edited, installed, tested or posted.

**Findings report:** 0 findings. One uncertain item at `.github/workflows/mirror-to-ghcr.yml:1` (deleted): the GHCR tag gap, which is harmless once #8719 is merged.
